name: Double-Entry Accounting & Ledger
author: Lensetek
description: Local SQLite double-entry bookkeeping with Chart of Accounts, General & Special Journals, General Ledger, Trial Balance, Income Statement, and Balance Sheet.
description_id: Pembukuan akuntansi double-entry berbasis SQLite lokal dengan Bagan Akun (CoA), Jurnal Umum & Khusus, Buku Besar, Neraca Saldo, Laba Rugi, dan Neraca.
description_cn: 基于本地 SQLite 的复式记账会计插件：支持会计科目表、通用/特种日记账、总分类账、试算平衡表、损益表与资产负债表。
